if: the document is a bill of supply referred to in clause (c) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 49 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the bill of supply MUST carry the Harmonised System of Nomenclature Code for the goods or services
note: One mandatory particular of rule 49(e), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: Harmonised System of Nomenclature Code for goods or services;
evidence.extraction_note: Rule 49(e) spells 'Code' with a capital C where rule 46(g) spells it 'code'. Both are quoted as they appear.
